Children.description: The items reach the node anchor of the outermost resource they are reached through: from the document, the tree's.

Tree.description: A tree whose children are in another resource, reached through $ref.

StrictTree.description: Reached through this resource, the nodes the other resource reaches are strict trees.

Forest.description: A $dynamicRef in a list of schemas.

StrictForest.description: Reached through this resource, it reaches this one's node there too.

Linked.description: A $ref to a $dynamicAnchor reaches it as an $anchor does, wherever the schema is used.

StrictLinked.description: So reached through this resource, the next node is still Linked; a $dynamicRef in its examples is data.
